nice-c-te-d-azur-alpine-maritime-weekend.slogan: A 250 km loop out of Alpine Maritime Weekend
nice-c-te-d-azur-alpine-maritime-weekend.story: A rider’s loop: clean exit, memorable middle, calm return. Out of Le Cannet and back again: 250 km, roughly 4 h 33 in the saddle. It goes by way of Vence, Scenic stretch near Roquebillière and near Roquebillière. The climb of the day is near Mandelieu-la-Napoule. It tops out at about 1,700 m. It crosses France, Italy and Monaco - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.

sections.advice: This High point near Mandelieu-la-Napoule → Vence stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Roquebillière → Photo stop near Roquebillière is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.
Photo stop near Roquebillière → Ospedaletti can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

scenicChapters.title: Dushanzi → Hashilegen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 241 km. 3400 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Hashilegen Pass → Nalati
scenicChapters.narrative: 3400 m come off over 94 km at around 6.7%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
